basis: Recurrent cessation of breathing defines this respiratory disorder; cardiovascular and neurologic sequelae are not intrinsic across the umbrella.
Loss of speech output includes organic neurologic dysfunction; this broad concept is not restricted to psychiatric selective mutism.

Eccrine skin tumors and characteristic eyelid abnormalities define the syndrome.
Defined as nonsyndromic hearing loss; MYH9 alone does not establish hematologic or renal disease.
Renal collecting-system abnormalities and sensorineural deafness define the syndrome; both occur in 80-99%.
Developmental impairment and epilepsy define the disease; structural scoliosis is reported in 2/4 patients (50%).
Cerebellar maldevelopment and degeneration cause ataxia; liver dysfunction occurs in only 5-29%; nystagmus does not establish eye damage.
Congenital displacement or abnormal positioning of the knee joint.

Primary malignant melanocytic tumor of skin; potential metastases do not establish common damage to another axis.
Defining abnormalities affect eyelids, palate and teeth, and limb skeleton; all three axes are intrinsic to the syndrome.
Neutrophil chemotactic dysfunction defines a phagocyte immunodeficiency; no additional organ has established common direct damage in this subtype.
Carcinoma arises in the larynx, which belongs to the airway axis; dysphagia alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Barium deposition is located in lung parenchyma; the definition explicitly describes preserved lung function and reversible lesions.
Progressive carpotarsal osteolysis; renal insufficiency in 15/19 (~79%); corneal opacity in 3/9 (~33%), a borderline estimate from a small sample.
Benign hair-follicle tumor occupying dermis or subcutis; associated syndromes do not establish additional organ involvement.
Mediastinal B-cell lymphoid malignancy; lymphoma requires the immune mechanism axis, while mediastinal location alone does not imply lung damage.
Localized mast-cell proliferation occupies skin; frequent diarrhea reflects mediator release and does not establish gastrointestinal infiltration or damage.
Compensatory parathyroid hormone excess from nonrenal causes; skeletal damage varies with cause and duration and is not established in >=30% across this group.
Cardiac and limb malformations define structural involvement; VSD and clinodactyly occur in 80-99%. Transient hypertrichosis is excluded; other defects lack frequencies.
Structural skeletal myopathy; respiratory failure in 2/2 supports ventilatory loss of function; cleft palate in 2/4 (50%) establishes gastrointestinal involvement.
Uncoupled mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation defines an energy-metabolism disorder; additional organ damage is not established by the supplied record.
Wolff-Parkinson-White conduction abnormality and developmental delay define the syndrome; facial dysmorphism alone does not establish additional organ damage.
Skeletal and dental maldevelopment define CCD; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Separately diagnosed sinus and respiratory infections are excluded.
